QuestInfo.0: It's not that you don't trust #p3001005#, but something just doesn't feel right. Go talk to #p3001004#.
QuestInfo.1: #p3001004# doesn't understand why #p3001005# told you to obtain poison vials for the antidote either. The antidote needs antibodies, not more poison. He tells you that the tissues of Specters that are immune to the poison are much more important and asks you to obtain #b50 #t4000732# items from #o2400111##k monsters.
